section.title: Why Self-Storage Operators Choose Postalocity
section.description: Streamline tenant communications while maintaining compliance — save hours weekly on mailing tasks.

benefits.title: Reclaim Operational Hours
benefits.description: Eliminate manual envelope stuffing and post office runs. Upload tenant documents, approve, and we handle printing, folding, stuffing, sealing, and mailing.
benefits.detail: Staff previously spending hours on mailing can focus on tenant relations and facility management.

benefits.title: Reduce Returned Mail
benefits.description: Real-time address verification catches invalid addresses before printing — dramatically reducing undeliverable mail and ensuring critical notices reach tenants.
benefits.detail: Reduces returned mail by up to 40% in high-volume scenarios, preventing compliance issues with lien deadlines.

benefits.title: Proof of Mailing Every Letter
benefits.description: Every mailing includes digital proof of mailing — essential for lien compliance and tenant disputes. Upgrade to Certified Mail for full USPS tracking with delivery confirmation.
benefits.detail: Meets state legal requirements for lien notices and auction notifications.

benefits.title: Secure & Compliant Handling
benefits.description: ISO 9001 documented processes protect sensitive tenant information. Encrypted file transfers and secure processing ensure data compliance.
benefits.detail: Your tenant data stays protected from upload through delivery.
